Liam: Quick non-work bulletin—three reasons to celebrate today: Carol got promoted to Staff SWE 🎉, Tia + Marc just got engaged 💍, and Vince closed on a new house this morning 🏡. Mini office celebration?
Liam: Thinking cake and a short toast in conf A later today.
Carol: Oh my gosh!!! Thank you all so much ❤️ I am floored.
Tia: we are so excited, will share photos soon.
Marc: she said yes!! tiny ring, huge feelings 😭
Vince: housewarming tacos pls 🌮 also open invite for a tour next weekend
Olivia: congrats everyone!! cake in the kitchen Thursday? I'm in for baking.
Sam: want to do a group card and maybe a pooled gift? happy to organize the card.
HR-bot: Heads up: please use the Gifts form (https://forms.redwood/gifts) if contributing to pooled gifts. Recommended range: $75–150 for team contributions.
Nora: (jumping in) I can bring disposable plates & napkins.
Carol: low-key toast in conf A at 4pm would be awesome if folks can make it.
Liam: confirmed 4pm conf A. I'll bring coffee and a little speaker for background music.
Olivia: lemon bars incoming :lemon: I'll drop them off at 3:30.
Tia: omg you all, this is the nicest team. Thank you. We'll DM photos later.
Sam: quick poll: cake vs donuts vs empanadas — react with :cake:, :doughnut:, or :taco: to vote.
Liam: (30–40 reactions roll in over the next hour, mostly :cake:)
Olivia: cake wins by a hair, noted ✅
Vince: I'll DM people about best weekend for a house tour.
Carol: seriously you all made my day. see you at 4pm 🎉
Liam: Huge congrats to all three — small celebration, huge joy :tada:
